verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm. Its evidenced offerings are legal services, glossaries, and a LathamDrive document generator, not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client. Plugging MCP servers in to extend its tool use is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agentic or tool-calling capability that would make the axis apply.
